name: Bishoujo Tsuiseki Shoukougun
source:
Main character has a one million yen debt. He's approached by a thug demanding to return the debt before the appointed date. Main character has 10,000 yen oh his hands and the whole town to devise a scheme how to return the debt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公背负100万日元债务。一名恶棍找上门，要求他在期限前还清欠款。主人公手头只有1万日元，却拥有整座城镇，可以想办法筹钱还债。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndreview[/url]]
